entry.title: Queue the sentence and run-loop items
entry.content:
Queue the sentence and run-loop items

TODO gains six open items. A productive target should be filled only by
a sentence whose last used word is the target's word; today a
productive target filled by a sentence clozed on another word yields no
card. Run-loop termination belongs in the CLI as `run --cycles N` and
`--spend-cap`; the scratchpad runner is the interim. `ask_many` should
warn when a key repeats within one call. Wire-failure messages
interpolate the request URL, which carries the Google TTS and Forvo API
keys; a timeout can put a key in a log. The fill-set memo is keyed by
text_sha and ignores voice, and the met-by scan is quadratic in adopted
sentences. Glue-word pronunciations are disputed placeholders awaiting
the adjudication pass. The cutover section records that runs 1-7 and
the overnight cycles are done.

entry.title: Map a TTS wire failure to TransportError
entry.content:
Map a TTS wire failure to TransportError

GoogleTts.synthesize raises TransportError on a requests exception
(timeout, connection); the run skips the source for the rest of the run
and counts it under source_failures (spec 3 §6a). A read timeout from
the TTS endpoint killed a live run with a traceback.

entry.title: Revise spec 1 to r7 and spec 3 to r15: mention by decomposition; prom…
entry.content:
Revise spec 1 to r7 and spec 3 to r15: mention by decomposition; prompt vocabulary met in the fill-set sense

Spec 1 §3 clause 1: a word is mentioned when it is a token or a
component of a token that decomposes wholly into registered words; a
prefix or suffix alone is no mention; thai_cloze shares the rule. Spec 3
§5: the drafting prompt lists the vocabulary met in the fill-set sense
and hands the unmet sentence-introduced targets as introducible, one
per sentence, one sentence per item.

Evidence: run 7 on the live deck: the prefix rule made "very" a mention
of "come"; the drafter was told early-placed glue words were available
and used 2 to 6 per sentence; 11 of 12 drafts filled nothing.

entry.title: Fill at most one unmet sentence-introduced target per sentence
entry.content:
Fill at most one unmet sentence-introduced target per sentence

fills, the sentence attempt, adoptable_drafts and the fills-novelty
rule apply one rule over a sentence's fill set: every content token
registered, every used word targeted, at most one sentence-introduced
target unmet by an adopted sentence placed at or before it (spec 1 r6
§3). The attempt checks fills against every open target the text
mentions, and the judge sees the last used word.

entry.title: Revise spec 1 to r6: one unmet sentence-introduced target per sentence
entry.content:
Revise spec 1 to r6: one unmet sentence-introduced target per sentence

§3 fills clause 3 is a rule over the fill set: every content token
registered, every used word targeted, at most one filled Target
sentence-introduced and unmet by an adopted sentence placed at or
before this one; applied once per sentence by acceptance, adoption and
the gate. §2: a word whose targets are all sentence-introduced carries
no category.

Evidence: the final review of the parsimonious-sentences arc (a
registered glue word was never "new", so two could enter in one
sentence; the per-target budget adopted a sentence the gate then
refused).

entry.title: Require a category of picture-introduced words only
entry.content:
Require a category of picture-introduced words only

A word whose targets are all sentence-introduced carries no category;
the curated loader and writer check picture-introduced words (spec 1
r6 §2). Glue words and classifiers are not thematic vocabulary.

entry.title: Compile one note per adopted sentence, clozed on its last used word
entry.content:
Compile one note per adopted sentence, clozed on its last used word

Syllabus.last_used_word names the word a sentence enters the order
after. Compile emits one sentence note per adopted sentence at that
position, TargetWord and cloze on that word, a target tag per filled
target, guid = text_sha; word notes only for picture-introduced words.
The import anchors a sentence card on its text_sha (spec 4 r5).

entry.title: Draft sentences for coverage; fill every open target a text contains
entry.content:
Draft sentences for coverage; fill every open target a text contains

The drafting prompt carries one cutoff for the batch and asks for the
fewest natural sentences covering the handed targets. drafts_in yields
one draft per distinct text with merged claims and drops a text whose
listings disagree on the gloss. fills is checked against every open
target whose word the text contains; the drafter's claim is a hint
(spec 3 r14 §5).

entry.title: Orthographic marks carry no vocabulary; pictures are required of pict…
entry.content:
Orthographic marks carry no vocabulary; pictures are required of picture-introduced words

A token of repetition or abbreviation marks, whitespace, punctuation or
digits never counts as a new word in fills (spec 1 r5 §3).
target/picture-required and the picture need cover words with a
picture-introduced target; recording-required covers every targeted
word.
